name: file-insert
description: Insert text after a specific line number without needing a unique string anchor. --line 0 inserts at the top, -1 appends to the end.
use_when: inserting lines at a position rather than by matching text

args.name: --line
args.description: Insert after this line; 0 = top of file, -1 = end.

args.name: --text
args.description: Text to insert; omit to read stdin.

exit_codes.1: I/O error or line out of range

notes: Line numbers shift after each insert — re-locate by content when chaining edits.
